class.name: Serde
class.brief_description: A resource that converts itself to and from a [PackedByteArray].
class.description: Send or save the bytes from [method serialize], and read them back with [method deserialize]. [codeblock] var bytes := payload.serialize() copy.deserialize(bytes) [/codeblock] Extend it and override [method _serialize] and [method _deserialize]. [DictionaryRecord] is an example.

method.name: _deserialize
method.description: Override it to read this resource from [param bytes] written by [method _serialize].

method.name: _serialize
method.description: Override it to convert this resource to bytes.

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Reads this resource from [param bytes]. Calls [method _deserialize].

method.name: serialize
method.description: Converts this resource to bytes. Calls [method _serialize], and returns an empty array when it is not overridden.
